title: Quantifying the Intrinsic Usefulness of Attributional Explanations for Graph Neural Networks with Artificial Simulatability Studies
reasoning: The paper focuses on quantifying the technical usefulness and quality of attributional explanations for Graph Neural Networks using artificial simulatability studies. While the introduction briefly mentions anti-discrimination laws as a general motivation for Explainable AI, the core of the paper's methodology and experiments does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The STS metric proposed is a technical measure of explanation quality.
